verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cloud file-collaboration product like Dropbox. However, the pack has no evidence of real-time browser co-editing of docs, sheets or slides, whether native or through a documented integration such as an office-suite connector. The closest items are adjacent: PDF editing, editor-vs-viewer sharing permissions, and near-instant syncing of shared folder contents. None of these is simultaneous in-place co-editing.

support.subject: As an operations lead, documents are editable in place — real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, native or via a documented integration
